title: Upload to itch.io enabled
author: thelionskywalker
selftext:
Just a little update on our vibe-coding game builder.

Before today, any games you made with us were kind of stuck inside our app. They’d get created and then…that was it. Almost like they'd pop into existence, then vanish when you closed us down. It felt a little like losing a cool drawing when you’ve run out of paper.

Now, you can push upload games to itch.io.

Doing this behind the scenes was an adventure. First, we had to straighten up whatever disorderly mess the AI dumped your project files into. Next, we chased down all the asset links the AI promised “definitely worked this time” and made sure they actually did. Also, we made sure exporting is consistent, so if you do it again, nothing sneaky gets changed in the background.

It’s still a bit clunky, but now the basic idea is: type in what you want, get a playable HTML5 game, then instantly publish it on itch.

If anyone’s interested, I’m happy to talk more about how we made it work.
